## Data-Use Terms (Summary)

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## <i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i>&nbsp; Demo terms
The terms below are placeholder/illustrative language for this proof of
concept, modeled on common academic data-sharing agreements. They are not a
legally reviewed policy.
:::

1. **Academic, non-commercial use only.** Datasets on this portal may be used
   for coursework, theses, dissertations, and non-commercial research.
2. **No redistribution.** Do not re-publish or redistribute raw data files
   outside your research team without permission.
3. **Attribution required.** Always cite the original data provider and
   Takwimu Bridge using the suggested citation on each dataset's page.
4. **Report responsibly.** When publishing findings, avoid presenting
   sample/placeholder figures (in this demo) or small-sample statistics
   (in production) as nationally representative without appropriate caveats.
5. **Sensitive topics.** Datasets covering sensitive subjects (e.g. gender-based
   violence) may require an additional ethics/IRB clearance in production.

## Citation Requirements

Each dataset page includes a **Suggested Citation** in the Dataset Details
section. At minimum, a citation should include: the data provider, the year,
the dataset title, "Takwimu Bridge" as the distributing portal, and the
retrieval date. Example:

> National Bureau of Statistics (NBS). (2022). *Tanzania Population and
> Housing Census — Sample Extract* [Data set]. Takwimu Bridge (demo portal).
> Retrieved 2026-07-29 from `https://example.org/datasets/tanzania-population-census`.

## The Request Process

1. Browse the [Data Catalog](catalog.html) and open a dataset's detail page.
2. Click **Request Access** — this opens the [Request Access](request-access.html)
   form with the dataset pre-selected.
3. Fill in your university, student ID, research purpose, and supervisor
   details, then agree to the terms above.
4. *(Production)* An administrator reviews and approves or follows up on your
   request; you're notified by email.
5. *(Production)* The **Download** button unlocks on the dataset's page.

## Expected Turnaround

**3–5 business days** is the target turnaround in the intended production
workflow (placeholder SLA — to be confirmed with partner universities).

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is this connected to a real database or login system yet?**
No. This is a static proof-of-concept site. The Request Access form posts to
a form-service placeholder, and "Pending Approval" / "Download" states on
dataset pages are simulated, not backed by real access control.
<!-- TODO: backend -->

**Can I download data right now?**
Not real data — each dataset page includes a small, clearly-labeled
placeholder CSV sample and preview table so you can see the data's shape,
but the Download button itself is disabled to demonstrate the intended
gated-access flow.

**Who approves requests in production?**
This would be a nominated administrator — likely a university library staff
member or portal maintainer — reviewing requests against the stated research
purpose and supervisor confirmation.

**What if my university isn't listed?**
The university dropdown on the request form is a placeholder list. Select
"Other" and note your institution in the Research Purpose field, or reach
out via [Contact](contact.html).

**Can I request more than one dataset at once?**
Yes — the "Dataset(s) Requested" field on the request form supports multiple
selections.

**Is there a cost to use the portal?**
No — the portal itself is intended to be free for students at partner
universities. Individual dataset licenses/terms are shown on each dataset page.
